Our primary care services

Comprehensive care, close to home.

We offer the full range of primary care services your family needs — all under one roof, right here in Peosta. No need to drive to Dubuque for excellent care.

01

Annual Physicals & Wellness Exams

Comprehensive head-to-toe exams for all ages. We review your health history, order preventive screenings, update immunizations, and set goals for the year ahead. Your annual physical is the foundation of staying healthy — not just catching problems.

02

Sick Visits

When you're not feeling well, you need to be seen quickly. We offer same-day appointments whenever possible for illnesses, infections, injuries, and other acute concerns. No waiting a week when you feel awful today.

→
03

Chronic Disease Management

Diabetes, hypertension, high cholesterol, thyroid disease, COPD, asthma — ongoing conditions require ongoing relationships. We partner with you for the long haul, adjusting treatment plans and monitoring progress over time so your condition never manages you.

04

Preventive Care & Screenings

The best time to address a health issue is before it becomes one. We follow evidence-based guidelines for cancer screenings, cardiovascular risk assessment, diabetes prevention, and immunizations — keeping you ahead of problems, not behind them.

05

Well-Child Visits

From newborn checkups through adolescence, we track your child's growth, development, and immunizations at every stage. We're a resource for parents too — no question is too small when it comes to your child's health.

→
06

Mental Health Screening & Support

We screen for anxiety, depression, and other mental health concerns as part of our whole-person approach to care. For many patients, primary care is the first and most trusted place to start that conversation — and we take it seriously.

07

Lab Work & Diagnostic Testing

On-site lab orders and coordination for bloodwork, urinalysis, imaging referrals, and other diagnostics. We review your results with you and explain what they mean in plain language — not medical jargon.

08

Specialist Referrals & Care Coordination

When you need a specialist, we don't just hand you a phone number. We coordinate your referral, communicate with the specialist, and follow up with you after — so nothing falls through the cracks.

Common questions

Good questions deserve real answers.

Are you accepting new patients?

Yes — we are actively welcoming new patients of all ages. Call us at (563) 588-6659 or book online at burdsfamilypractice.com to get started. We'd love to be your family's healthcare home.

What insurance do you accept?

We accept most major commercial insurance plans. We also offer a Direct Primary Care membership for patients without insurance or those who prefer an alternative to the traditional model. Call us to confirm your specific plan.

Can you be my child's doctor AND my doctor?

Absolutely. We provide primary care for patients of all ages — from newborns through seniors. Many of our families have multiple generations under our care, which gives us a rich picture of your family's health history.

Do you offer telehealth appointments?

We offer telehealth for select visit types when clinically appropriate. Call our office to find out if your visit qualifies for a virtual appointment.

What is the difference between a regular patient and a DPC member?

Standard patients visit us under traditional insurance billing. Direct Primary Care (DPC) members pay a flat monthly fee and receive unlimited visits with no copays, same-day access, and direct contact with their provider. Ask us if DPC might be a better fit for your needs.

Do you offer sports physicals and school forms?

Yes — we complete sports physicals, school physical forms, camp physicals, and other required paperwork for children and teens. Call ahead to schedule and let us know what you need so we can have the right forms ready.

Your family deserves a doctor who knows your name.

We're accepting new patients from Peosta, Asbury, Cascade, Dubuque, Farley, Dyersville, and all of western Dubuque County. Same-day appointments available. Let's get started.
